user.title: Albert Heijn login
user.description:
1. Open [the AH login page]({authorize_url}) and log in.
2. The page redirects to an `appie://login-exit?code=...` address that the browser cannot open. Copy that address (or just the `code` value) from the address bar or the error page.
3. Paste it below. The code is single-use and expires quickly, so paste it right away.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Albert Heijn
reauth_confirm.description: The stored login has expired. Open [the AH login page]({authorize_url}), log in, and paste the new `appie://login-exit?code=...` address or code below.

error.invalid_auth: The code was rejected. Codes are single-use and expire within minutes — get a fresh one and try again.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Albert Heijn API. Try again later.

abort.already_configured: This Albert Heijn account is already configured.
abort.wrong_account: The code belongs to a different Albert Heijn account than this entry.

data.sync_target_entity: Existing to-do list to push to Albert Heijn (optional)

data_description.update_interval: How often to fetch the koopzegels balance. The balance only changes when you shop, so keep this modest — the API is unofficial.
data_description.list_enabled: Expose the AH shopping list ("Mijn lijst") and enable the manual push into it.
data_description.list_scan_interval: How often to poll the shopping list for changes made in the AH app. Only used for the dedicated Albert Heijn to-do entity; with a list picked below there is no background polling at all.
data_description.sync_target_entity: Pick an existing to-do list, e.g. the built-in Shopping list, to push onto the Albert Heijn list instead of creating a separate Albert Heijn entity. Pushing is one-way and only happens when you press the sync button or call the Sync shopping list action. Leave empty to get a dedicated entity you can wire up yourself.

no_sync_target.message: No Albert Heijn entry is set up to sync a to-do list. Enable the shopping list and pick a to-do list in the integration options first.

entry_not_synced.message: That Albert Heijn entry is not loaded or has no to-do list to sync. Pick a to-do list in its options first.

multiple_entries.message: More than one Albert Heijn account is set up to sync. Add the 'Albert Heijn account' field to say which one to push.

sync_shopping_list.name: Sync shopping list
sync_shopping_list.description: Pushes a Home Assistant to-do list onto the Albert Heijn shopping list. Items open in Home Assistant are added to the app; items completed in Home Assistant are checked off there. Items that only exist in the AH app are left alone, and nothing is ever written back into Home Assistant.

entity_id.name: To-do list
entity_id.description: The list to push. Defaults to the list picked in the integration options.

config_entry_id.name: Albert Heijn account
config_entry_id.description: Which Albert Heijn entry to push with. Only needed when more than one account is set up to sync.
